items.comments: Cool little house, great location near Ballard restaurants/bars/brewpubs. Alex was very responsive. I'd rent it again next time in Seattle.
Nice spacious house in a peaceful neighborhood of Seattle that is also walkable to interesting things to see and do (including very close to the zoo).  Host was communicative and we had a great stay!
Easily found.  Corner of a somewhat busy street, the evenings were quiet.  Nice little home away from home.
Very nice home.  Good view.  it's on a quiet street, but not too far from all of the bars and restaurants in Ballard/Fremont.
